thread:
Alex: Pushed a quick perf dump from yesterday's stress run. Seeing weird stalls in streaming on route /chat/stream — client-side chunk gaps look small but server-side chunk emit time has a long tail. link: https://internal.redwood/perf/178234
Maria: Nice. Can you attach the token-level breakdown? we need client vs server split, and kernel decision logs.
Alex: Attached CSV in the perf link. High-level: median chunk cadence ~50ms but P99 is ~1.2s. KV cache hit-rate drops correlate with the long tail. I pasted a small sample below.
Jin: Do we have kernel fallback logs? Last time we saw a similar tail it was due to switching from fused-attn to fallback kernel at sequence >1024.
Alex: Yep. Trace shows kernel=qa_fused at start then fallback=matmul_sparse at the spike. stack tag: kernel_choice=fallback
Tao: Can we add a dashboard panel that splits token_latency into: client_decode, server_generate, kernel_exec, kv_lookup? Right now we only surface total server_time.
Maria: +1. Also add per-route KPIs: streaming_chunk_p95/p99, kv_hit_rate_by_prefix_len, batching_latency_by_batch_size
PerfBot: Suggested metric names: streaming.chunk.cadence_ms, streaming.chunk.server_exec_ms, streaming.chunk.client_gap_ms, kv.cache.hit_rate, runtime.kernel.choice
Alex: Proposed alert: stream_stall_ratio > 0.5% over 5m OR server_exec_p99 > 800ms triggers page.
Jin: For instrumentation, include trace_id in every chunk event and tag kernel_choice + batch_shape. Then we can correlate spikes to batching heuristics.
Tao: Also log kv_lookup.key_len and kv_lookup.prefix_len so we can see if long prefixes cause cache misses.
Maria: For visualizations, we should add a waterfall per request showing time spent in: intake->routing->batch_wait->kernel->kv->send_chunk. Make each box hoverable with trace link.
Alex: Small example of event emission (pseudo):
```json
{
  "trace_id":"abc123",
  "event":"chunk_emit",
  "chunk_index":3,
  "client_gap_ms":42,
  "server_exec_ms":510,
  "kernel_choice":"matmul_sparse",
  "batch_shape":"b=8,s=256",
  "kv_hit":false
}
```
Jin: That payload is good. If we sample at 5% we should have enough data without high cardinality.
Tao: For dashboards, add a stacked histogram by kernel_choice for server_exec_ms to spot which kernels produce long tails.
Maria: One more: per-route cost-per-token metric (cpu_ms + gpu_ms + kv_cost) so product can decide which routes to move to dedicated pool.
Alex: Quick triage notes: regression introduced in commit 0f3a2b (batching heuristics change). Repro steps: run local stress with seq=2048, burst=32, and enable kv warmup=false.
Maria: I'll file a ticket with screenshots and link to traces. Assigning to Jin for kernel correlation and to infra for KV warmup experiment.
PerfBot: Ticket created: PERF-1123. Slack thread pinned. :white_check_mark:
Jin: I'll start with kernel-op counters and add kernel selection telemetry to the runtimes metrics. ETA EOD.
Tao: I'll prototype the dashboard panels and the waterfall widget tomorrow morning.
Alex: Thanks all — let's try to get the P99 under 300ms for streaming. If anyone adds instrumentation, ping here with the metric name so we can wire it into the console.
